descriptionChirho: To restrain, hold back, or keep in check — the core meaning of actively preventing or curbing an action, person, or force.
To spare someone by withholding punishment or destruction, showing mercy by restraining one's hand from harm.
To withhold goods, resources, or generosity — refusing to give or share what one has.
To reserve or set aside something for future use, keeping it stored up rather than expending it now.
